name: Colorbars - A fun, addictive, and colorful match three puzzle game

ios.desc:
Colorbars is a completely new take on the match three puzzle game genre. It's an addictive strategy game based on the harmony of color. It can be played in minutes but will keep you hooked for hours. Your goal is to rearrange bars into sets of matching colors or runs of adjacent colors based on the color wheel in the fastest time possible.

Colorbars uses a minimalist UI and a simplistic gameplay that requires fast thinking and quick hands. It's a race against time, but the more bars you clear out, the longer you play. Is your knowledge of the color wheel up to speed? Can you make it to the top of the high scores?
